offers.name: Bet Return
offers.summary: An eligible cash fixed-odds win bet can return a bonus bet for the token’s specified finishing positions.
terms: Cap and qualifying places: shown on your token.
One per race; cannot combine with Power Play or another promotion.
Race-specific tokens expire after the race. Bonus bet is not a cash refund.

offers.name: Race Saver / Reload
offers.summary: Allocated offers can provide a bonus bet after a qualifying result or non-winning win bet.
terms: Your token defines the cap, qualifying results and races.
Once per person per race. Thoroughbred win offers require eight runners.
Bonus-funded, live or cashed-out bets can be excluded. Check the full token terms.

offers.name: Pump
offers.summary: An allocated Pump can enhance the odds on an eligible bet, with cash winnings.
terms: Maximum stake and potential payout are offer-specific.
Check eligible markets and expiry in the offer.
Cannot combine with another offer. Compare the resulting price, not the badge.
